name: Meredith Davies
body: I knew Paul through my husband Andrew. Paul was one of his oldest friends and one of the first people Andrew wanted me to meet when we started dating more seriously. By this point, neither Andrew or I lived in Rhode Island, but whenever we would visit, we, or at least Andrew, would without fail see Paul. Even if it was just a short weekend to see Andrew's mom, Paul always made time, popping over to Andrew's house to chat after dinner or say what up before we headed out. If he was picking up Andrew so the two of them could go play pool, Paul would always come inside for a few minutes for a hug and a hello. He would go out of his way to be helpful and generous, although, sometimes this turned into a tiny fiasco that gave us a good laugh -- like the time he lent us a car for a week, which turned out to be infested with ants who helped themselves to the strip pizzas that were supposed to feed to our friends (including Paul) at a beach day! Paul was just so reliably and so comfortably woven into our lives, and I have a feeling that many people who knew Paul feel the same way. He was easy to get to know, easy to hang out with, easy to love. We'll miss him forever.
